opportunities.description: One evening, ninety minutes, proper session. Open to adults who are between clubs and want to train with a squad, and to our own players who need extra minutes. No pressure and no cuts: it is a training night, not a trial, though the reserves' coach will be watching and he is always short of a centre-half. Finishes with a 9-a-side game. Tea in the clubhouse afterwards.
opportunities.instructions: 3G cage behind the clubhouse. Meet at 19:15 for a 19:30 start. No metal studs.
opportunities.title: Open training night with the Reserves

opportunities.description: We are two or three players short of the squad we want for the winter. If you are 18 or over and believe you can play Wendle & District Premier Division football, apply here. We read every application. Players we like are invited into a first-team training night first, so we see you with the group rather than in a line of bibs; the open trial match at the end is for everyone we have not managed to see by then. Everyone gets an answer, and if it is a no we will tell you why.
opportunities.instructions: Arrive 30 minutes before the start and report to the clubhouse. Bring boots for grass and for 3G, shin pads, water and a waterproof. Parking is on the gravel behind the clubhouse.
opportunities.position_requirements: All positions. We are short of a left-back, a centre-half and a striker.
opportunities.title: Open trial — First Team

opportunities.description: Our under-21 left-back leaves for university in January and we want his replacement training with the group before he goes. You will play in the Fenmouth Counties Development League on Tuesday nights and train twice a week. The under-21s are where our first team comes from: four of the current first-team squad were in this side eighteen months ago. No fixed trial date — if we like your profile, Sunil will invite you to a session.
opportunities.instructions: Tell us where you have played, which foot, and what nights you can train.
opportunities.position_requirements: Left-back or left wing-back. Left-footed preferred, not essential.
opportunities.title: Left-back wanted — Under-21s
